# Tano Core 0.8.1

- Refine document menus, page display settings, configurable shortcuts and inline source navigation.
- Keep workspace opening responsive, preserve recovery layouts, and recover safely after workspace metadata deletion.
- Animate outline expansion and collapse, keep controls separate from scrolling headings, and refine sidebar and floating assistant presentation.
- Complete English shortcut labels and align assistant/settings tests with the current browser APIs and controls.

Cloud delivery uses this Core release; desktop installers and mobile distribution are outside this release scope.
Validation commands and the tested SHA are retained in private release evidence after the complete checks finish.
